title: Regulatory Intelligence & Variation Tracker
short: Monitors new guidelines and requirements across target markets, summarizes what changed and tracks which products and submissions are affected.
symptom: New regulations are discovered too late
ingredient: A regulatory watch and impact tracker
directions: Choose the authorities and product portfolio to follow. Get a weekly digest of changes with the affected products and submissions.
problem: Regulatory teams follow many authorities, each publishing guidelines, labeling updates and procedural changes; tracking variations and country-specific requirements is manual and spread across emails and spreadsheets.
why: A missed requirement can cause rejected submissions, non-compliant labels or delayed variations.
solution: Collects updates from selected authority websites, summarizes the change in plain language with a link to the source, maps it to affected products, and keeps a tracker of submissions, variations and deadlines.
data: Product portfolio and registration status per country
impact: One view of submissions across countries
limitations: Summaries can miss nuance; the official text always prevails
Some authorities publish in formats that are hard to monitor
review: Regulatory specialists interpret every change and decide the action plan.
